name: Nanahoshi
source:
Formerly a "cinema hero" who originated from the yang-yang republic. An action film actor who was active decades ago, but was revived by a bug. His tone is blunt and he appears youthful, but he's oftentimes called a "ojiichan."

He has a somewhat sensible atmosphere and is highly apathetic to horror. However, he's not really good with "insects." Despite his appearance and personality, he still plays a role that confuses other members.
